offline.title: Stashed Charts
offline.intro: Stash a realm's chart, or a port with its 3D taverns and forts, right in yer chest, so the Sea Chart still unfolds when ye sail into dead waters. The radar, lookout readings, and weather still need a carrier pigeon (internet).
alerts.title: Thunderbolt Warnings
alerts.intro: A cannon shot when thunderbolts strike near yer stashed havens in Singapore (by NEA) or Canada (by Environment Canada), even when UwU Weather is battened down.
alerts.telegram-unlinked: Lashed this vessel to the Telegram parrot under Sync Yer Havens, and the bird can squawk these warnings too.

sync.title: Sync Yer Havens
sync.code-hint: Squawk /code at the parrot for six digits, or crack open one o' yer spare ciphers when Telegram is beyond the horizon.
sync.saved-hint: This vessel and the parrot share one logbook. Stashing a haven in one scribes it in the other.
sync.backup-hint: Single-shot ciphers for boarding again when Telegram be marooned. Give the nod in the chat, and the ciphers will flash here just once.

wx.uv-advice.low: No shade needed for most salts.
wx.uv-advice.moderate: Stick to the shadow o' the sails at high noon, and don a tricorn hat if topside for long.
wx.uv-advice.high: Cover yer hide, slather on the salve, and seek shade 'twixt 11am and 3pm.
wx.uv-advice.very-high: Beware the midday sun! Tunic, tricorn, eye-patch, and sun salve required.
wx.uv-advice.extreme: Stay below deck if ye value yer hide! Full armor required topside.
wx.heat-advice.low: All hands on deck as usual, with plenty o' water and grog breaks.
wx.heat-advice.moderate: Swig water more often and take breathers from heavy hauling topside.
wx.heat-advice.high: Belay the heavy hauling topside! Rest in the shade of the sails and swig water steady.
